name: WhatConverts
description: WhatConverts is a lead tracking and reporting platform that attributes calls, form submissions, chats, and e-commerce transactions back to the specific marketing campaign, keyword, or channel that generated them.
best_for: Marketing agencies, PPC/SEO professionals, and business owners across industries like real estate, legal, healthcare, and home services who need to trace every call, form, and chat lead back to its exact marketing source.
features: Call tracking with dynamic number insertion and automatic spam blocking
Form tracking for existing website forms
Chat tracking tied back to marketing campaigns
Lead search and filtering by name, number, or email
Lead valuation for ROI comparison across channels
CRM export and automated lead sync
Pre-built marketing reports plus a custom report builder
Multi-click/multi-touch attribution across the customer journey
1000+ integrations, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and Pipedrive
pros: Over 1000 integrations with ad platforms and CRMs
AI-powered lead qualification to filter out junk leads
White label option built specifically for agencies
cons: Individual-business plans are limited to a single account — multiple accounts require an Agency plan starting at $500/mo
Usage credits are capped per plan tier, with per-item overage charges for extra tracked numbers, minutes, and form/chat submissions

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free analytics tool from Google that measures customer behavior across websites and apps.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want free, general-purpose web analytics rather than dedicated call/form/chat lead-source attribution

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: A CRM platform where businesses track contacts, deals, and marketing activity in one place.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want lead tracking bundled into a broader CRM and marketing suite rather than a standalone attribution tool
